fields.content:
Holtz is a Claude Code plugin that audits codebases through a seven-phase process (recon, doc audit, test audit, adversarial review, TDD fix loop, pattern analysis, convergence). It ships as two skills (holtz, justine), two agents (holtz, justine), reference docs, Python scripts, a global pattern library, and tests.

  LICENSE

  .gitignore
  agents/
    holtz.md
    justine.md
  skills/
